name: Kenji Tanaka
household: Wife, married 45 years; adult daughter lives nearby
psychographics: Prioritizes harmony and saving for a rainy day; reluctant to trouble others with his own needs.
current_solutions: Uses a flip phone given to him by his grandson; pays utility bills at the konbini (convenience store) using cash; shops at the local Aeon supermarket for discount stickers on near-expiry items.
frustration: Tried to reserve a seat on the JR limited express at 8:42 AM using the station ticket machine; the machine rejected his elderly IC card three times and displayed an error code E-15, causing him to miss his train.
decision_style: Asks his wife or a neighbor for advice before trying anything new; trusts word-of-mouth from his peer group at the pachinko parlor more than advertisements.
voice: Rambling and polite; often starts sentences with 'Well, you see...' and apologizes even when describing a frustration; uses specific technical terms for machines but not for apps.
